en: Welcome to the Pretty Petal! We grow flowers, and berries too. Plant a berry in soft soil, and it grows into a tree.
Water it well, and it gives you more berries than you planted. Isn't nature generous?
Do you like plants? Then you'll want one of these. It's for watering berry trees!
Dry soil makes for a poor harvest. Water your berry trees often with the Wailmer Pail!
Hi! I give away one berry every day. Here's today's!
That was today's berry. Come back tomorrow for another!
